newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH JAN-SEPT BUILDING PERMITS UP 21 PCT - SF.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH JAN-SEPT BUILDING PERMITS UP 21 PCT - SF.

text.p: The construction volume for which building permits were granted rose 21 percent year-on-year in January-September to 24.3 million cubic metres, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Friday.
In September, the construction volume for which building permits were granted fell 13 percent year-on-year, SF said, but did not give absolute figures.
The number of building permits granted for new homes in September was 2,300, up almost 1,000 on September 1995, it said.
In January-September, the construction volume of new homes for which building permits were granted rose 27 percent to 18.9 million cubic metres, SF said.
Permits for industrial buildings rose nine percent year-on-year in January-September to nearly five million cubic metres.
